# E-Vox By Ekant

> Premium Cloud PBX & VoIP Solutions tailored for modern teams, offering reliable calling, seamless collaboration, and effortless scalability.

## Overview
E-Vox By Ekant provides a modern cloud phone system designed to upgrade business communications without the complexity of traditional hardware.

## Features
- **Cloud Business Phone System**: Work from anywhere without complicated hardware or maintenance.
- **Crystal-Clear Calling**: High-definition voice quality built for modern enterprises.
- **Smart Call Routing**: Intelligent call routing, IVR menus, extensions, and forwarding.
- **Business SMS**: Convenient two-way business text messaging.
- **Call Analytics**: Visual call reports, activity tracking, and performance insights.
- **Work From Anywhere**: Softphone apps available for web browsers, desktop apps, and mobile applications.

## Key Benefits
- **99.9% Uptime Guarantee**
- **24/7 Expert Support**
- **Seamless Scalability**: Add users and numbers instantly.
- **Number Portability**: Keep existing local, toll-free, or international numbers.
- **Hardware Agnostic**: Use softphones with headsets or compatible standard SIP/IP phones.
